g.text: Animation round trip: Blender / GLB / Vizij

text.tspan: Reloading it as a FACE would
Measured against Blender 5.2.1. A Vizij save writes each clip twice -- losslessly into VIZIJ_bundle and baked into glTF channels -- and
fingerprints what it wrote. Blender reads and edits the channels but its exporter drops unknown extensions, so the file it writes back has no
records: every animation then reads as import-new. keep-both-edited is only reachable when the records survive, which a Blender re-export
does not allow. Preserving them needs a companion Blender add-on using gather_import_gltf_before_hook and gather_gltf_extensions_hook.
any tool can see and edit
Both versions sit side by side.
Only a person can say which was meant.
